title: A quick one-liner
story: You just want to count the PDB files in /scratch/{{user}}/{{dataset}} as a job, without writing a script. Submit it with sbatch --wrap, naming the job {{jname}}.

lesson.title: A job without a script

parts.note: The command to run. sbatch wraps it in a tiny script for you. Quote it so the `|` belongs to the job, not to your shell.

lesson.why: Handy for one quick command. Anything longer is easier to fix in a script.
lesson.without: With no `--gres` or `--mem`, the job gets no GPU and the default memory, which is fine for a quick count.

hints: `--wrap="COMMAND"` turns a command into a job, and `--job-name` (or `-J`) names it.
